producer_report.summary:
`athena drain` now runs the items of one plan group at the same time, up to a new `[parallel] max_concurrency` setting. The default is 1 and the ceiling is 4. I did not run the drain against a real repository. The full `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass. An earlier full test run failed on an admission test, which I fixed (see the last item below).

**What changed**
- **Config and athena.toml, in one change:**
  - `Config` gains a `parallel` field with a `Parallel` struct, a default of 1 and a ceiling constant of 4 (`MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING`). A value outside 1 to 4 is refused when the config is parsed.
  - `athena.toml` gains `[parallel] max_concurrency = 1` in the same change, so the file parses at every commit.
  - The value keeps today's serial behaviour. A test parses the real file.
- **Drain:** `drain_parallel(steps, limits, ui, bound)` works the plan groups in order. Items of a group run on up to `bound` threads. A group finishes before the next starts, so a dependent item starts after what it needs. One item's failure or refusal stops no sibling.
- **Stop, budget and job limit:** a stop starts no further item. A started job holds its caps against the budget until it ends, and the job limit counts every worker, so together the workers cannot overspend or exceed the limit.
- **Rating:** with a bound above 1, one rating is taken per group, after its landings. Bound 1 uses the old serial loop unchanged, with a rating after each landing, and `drain()` keeps its signature.
- **Wiring:** `main.rs` reads the setting through `RealSteps::max_concurrency` and calls `drain_parallel`.
- **Tests:** six new tests in `crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs` cover bound 1 order, two items in flight together plus a dependent waiting, failure and refusal, the worker bound, budget and job limit, and stop. Three config tests cover the real `athena.toml`, an absent `[parallel]`, and the range.
- **Docs:** I removed "one job at a time" from the drain and plan docs, the `drain --help` text, README and roles-and-ladder. `parallel-jobs.md` gains a section on what this slice built and what remains. `CHANGELOG.md` has a new entry, which also names the `athena.toml` change.

**Files outside the deliverable list:**
- `gh.rs` and `jev.rs` (`athena-core`): `HttpPost` and `Evaluate` now require `Send + Sync`, so `Athena` can be shared across worker threads. The jev test transport moved from `RefCell` to `Mutex`.
- `admission.rs`: its "new section plus schema field" test used `[parallel]` as the example section. It now uses `[fanout]`, because `[parallel]` is a real section.
- `README.md` and `roles-and-ladder.md`: stale "one job at a time" text.

checks_run.note: Full workspace run, exit 0, after fixing one admission test that collided with the new [parallel] section. An earlier run failed on that test.
The 59 existing drain tests passed unchanged. The 6 new parallel:: tests passed.

criteria_check.criterion: A test loads the repository's real athena.toml (with its [parallel] section) through Config and passes; a config without [parallel] parses and yields max_concurrency 1; a config with an unknown top-level section is rejected. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: In crates/athena-data/src/config.rs: the_real_athena_toml_parses_with_its_parallel_section, a_config_without_parallel_runs_one_item_at_a_time, max_concurrency_must_lie_between_one_and_the_ceiling, and the existing unknown_keys_are_rejected. All pass in the full `cargo test --locked` run.

criteria_check.criterion: A drain test with bound 1 shows items run strictly in the existing order, and all existing drain tests pass unchanged. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: parallel::with_a_bound_of_one_items_run_one_after_another_in_plan_order asserts the exact log (start, end, land, rate per item), max in flight 1, and the same log from the unchanged `drain()`. The existing tests in tests/drain.rs are untouched and pass.

criteria_check.criterion: A drain test with bound 2 and two independent items in one group has both in flight at once (barrier; fails if serial), and an item depending on another starts only after it finishes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: parallel::with_a_bound_of_two_independent_items_are_in_flight_together_and_a_dependent_waits: a and b each wait until two runs are in flight; the test asserts they met and that most in flight is 2. A bound of 1 on the same kind of world never meets. It also asserts that "end a" and "land a" come before "start c", where c depends on a.

criteria_check.criterion: Tests show one item's failure or refusal does not stop its siblings, the worker bound is never exceeded, and Stop starts no further item. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: parallel::one_items_failure_or_refusal_does_not_stop_its_siblings (a fails twice, d is refused, b and c land), the_worker_bound_is_never_exceeded (6 items, bound 2, most in flight exactly 2), workers_together_never_spend_past_the_budget_or_the_job_limit, and a_stop_asked_for_starts_no_further_item (c and d never run).

criteria_check.criterion: Ordering and retry rules are unchanged; `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: The serial path keeps the old loop (run_serially). Retry and attempt logic in Drain::work is unchanged, apart from the job-limit check, which moved into run_job's locked section with the same order of checks. All existing tests pass. Clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check are clean.

criteria_check.criterion: athena.toml gains [parallel] only together with its schema field in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs in the same change; the field, default (1) and ceiling are documented where defined, and the athena.toml change is named and justified in the final report.
criteria_check.evidence: config.rs gains Config::parallel, the Parallel struct, the MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING constant (4) and a default of 1, all with doc comments. athena.toml gains [parallel] max_concurrency = 1 in the same change. The justification is in the summary and in CHANGELOG.md.

criteria_check.criterion: Drain and Report docs no longer say the loop runs one job at a time; docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and CHANGELOG.md state what this slice built and what remains (multi-job `athena go`, --pr phase).
criteria_check.evidence: Updated: the drain.rs module doc and the Report::plan_groups doc, the plan.rs module doc, the drain --help text in main.rs, README.md, and docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md. Added section 0 to docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and an Unreleased entry in CHANGELOG.md; both list built and not built. Older CHANGELOG entries and decisions.md still describe the earlier state, as history.

open_issues: I edited files outside the deliverables list: crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs (HttpPost: Send + Sync), crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs (Evaluate: Send + Sync, and the test transport moved from RefCell to Mutex), crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs (its probe section renamed from [parallel] to [fanout]), README.md and docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md (stale 'one job at a time' text). Each was needed to compile, to keep tests passing, or to fix stale docs.

Worker threads share one Athena. A panic in a worker ends the whole drain. parallel-jobs.md section 4.1 had preferred processes, and none of its four spike checks were run. This is stated in the new section 0 of that doc.
With a bound above 1 the page is rated once per group, not once per landing. Bound 1 rates after each landing, as before.
Groups from different plan waves are never run together, and a group runs to completion before the next starts. This is conservative and keeps dependency order.
Not built, as agreed: multi-job `athena go`, the --pr phase, and refusing at submit time a request whose configuration does not parse.
mistakes: My first stop test was racy: the sibling's stop check could run after the stop was set, so it never started. I fixed it by making the stopping job wait until a sibling is in flight.
I first set the test wait timeout to 10s, which made the serial-comparison cases slow. I lowered it to 3s.
learnings: Config uses deny_unknown_fields, and crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs has a test that adds a new [parallel] section to the base config. Once athena.toml really has [parallel], that test fails with a duplicate key.
Athena was not Sync, so RealSteps could not be shared across threads. The only blockers were jev::Evaluate and gh::HttpPost, which have no Send + Sync bound.
Plan::groups already holds the parallel groups: items with no dependency between them and disjoint touched paths. Items from different dependency waves are always in different groups.
Existing drain tests use RefCell stubs, so drain() keeps its non-Sync signature. The parallel path is a separate entry point, drain_parallel.
desires: A way to read a saved tool-result file. The sandbox policy blocked it, so I could not search the full cargo test output and relied on the exit status.
The test-suite wall time is long (about 2 minutes for the cli tests). A faster inner loop would have helped.
